newsitem.title: USA: AptarGroup Q1 sales up in core segments.
newsitem.headline: AptarGroup Q1 sales up in core segments.

text.p: AptarGroup Inc said Thursday record first quarter results were aided by increased sales in its fragrance/cosmetics, personal care and pharmaceutical segments.
"These results were achieved despite increased price competition and the stronger U.S. dollar," Carl Siebel, president, said in a statement.
Earlier, AptarGroup reported first quarter net income of $0.64 a share, up from $0.60 a year ago. Sales rose three percent to $158.3 million from $153.0 million.
"If the U.S. dollar exchange rate during the quarter had been the same as the prior year, sales would have increased approximately 10 percent for the quarter," Siebel said.
On net income, the adverse effect of a stronger U.S. dollar was offset by a net gain from differences in exchange rates on various inter-country transactions.

Siebel added that AptarGroup's new operation in China began production of aerosol valves. Production of dispensing closures and pumps is planned to be added there beginning in mid to late 1997, he said.
AptarGroup makes pumps, dispensing closures and aerosol valves. Shares were up 1-1/8 to 39-3/4.
